newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeks 600,000 bbls of crude for December.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeks 600,000 bbls of crude for December.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP is seeking 600,000 barrels for December delivery, traders said Thursday.
The purchase tender asks for the cargo to be delivered December 7-15. Offers are due November 13.

Uruguay usually buys one million barrels of spot crude every four to six weeks, but a planned shutdown of the 34,600 barrel per day (bpd) ANCAP refinery at La Teja around the end of January has trimmed short-term requirements.
ANCAP plans to replace the refinery's catalytic cracking unit during the shutdown, a company official said.

Uruguay recently bought West African, Iranian, Venezuelan crudes, and also has a term contract with neighboring Argentina for one cargo of 380,000 barrels of Medanito grade every 50 days. That contract expires next April.
